1/G.goal: Explain how XR, VR, AR, and MR are understood within immersive technology and the reality-virtuality continuum, and why XR is an important emerging field.
1/G.achieves: It provides the introductory conceptual foundation and motivation needed to follow the course's XR hardware, software, human-factors, and system-development topics.

1/O1.goal: Clarify the meanings of XR, VR, AR, and MR by explaining XR as an umbrella for immersive technologies and experiences and placing VR, AR, and MR on the reality-virtuality continuum.
1/O1.achieves: It gives learners the shared conceptual vocabulary needed to follow the course's later XR hardware, software, and human-factors content.

1/O2.goal: Explain why XR is an important emerging field by citing market growth, application domains, the metaverse, and demand for skilled practitioners.
1/O2.achieves: It supports the course aim of preparing learners to understand and implement XR systems by motivating the relevance and opportunities of foundational XR knowledge.
